﻿[color=#FFCC00][head=2]B[/head][bold]ASICS[/bold][/color] This version of our guidelines has been abridged for convenience. For more thorough documentation, please see our wiki at [color=#0088FF]lagrange14.com[/color].
• *You must be an 18+ adult to play.* We are an 18+ server, which means that, even if the focus is not on ERP, we absolutely allow discussing adult topics. If you do find yourself taking advantage of this for sensuality, we have a subtle emote prefix for that; it defaults to `-`.
• *You should expect to encounter every kind of delightful weirdness in identity.* We welcome characters of all ages; expect to see children and older characters, littles and caregivers. We welcome those embracing neurodivergence and tackling mental health issues. We welcome all sorts of others you can imagine. *Acknowledging that a character expresses the interests of a player, we do not welcome assholes.*
• *Be judicious in your expression of negativity.* Conflicts will arise, and we trust that we will be able to work through them, but they should not form the majority of our interactions.
[color=#FFCC00][head=2]R[/head][bold]OLEPLAY[/bold][/color] • *We are an HRP server.* We lean hard into using the mechanics of the game to help us tell deep and long-running stories.
• *Engage with the [textlink="lore" link="L5LoreBasics"].* Lagrange is set in the Post-Self universe, a generally peaceful, post-capitalist, non-Nanotrasen setting surrounding the System, a machine that dreams.
• *Act according to the role that your character has taken.* Skeleton crews mean that responsibilities are shared, yes, but keep in mind that your salvager character is probably not a master surgeon.
• *Keep IC information strictly IC until it ceases to be mechanically relevant.* We have open OOC and allow for communication outside the server about the round, but letting plots play out with only what your characters know in-game puts everyone on the same page.
• *Death leaves your mind hazy and your memories scrambled.* If you have been killed and need to be defibbed, are cloned, or are borged, you cannot remember the cause of your death.
• *Seek consent and respect boundaries.* When roleplaying around sensitive topics such as violence, bigotry, suicide, or other rough topics, do not hesitate to ask if it is alright to continue, or to state a boundary indicating that the topic is not something you can participate in. Negotiate beforehand and offer aftercare. *This is not license to engage in bigotry, unwanted advances, or other impositions on another character or player's identity.*
